fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not meet G22 state closure: "every bounded boundary marginal" is circular, and truncation through B+32 can omit states that become minimizing after later gluing. The base lattice, target, complete port alphabet, glue map, control, lambda/mu definitions, and recursive contract are not frozen, so the proposed search is not executable or genuinely discriminating.

Proposal 2 tests a trivial constant-size degree-three refutation of the formula containing every assignment-falsifying clause. It provides no compressed representation or polynomial degree bound for general unsatisfiable formulas, so even a pass cannot address G20/G21; the CVP target, anchor accounting, and unrestricted coefficient bound are also unspecified.

Proposal 3 leaves the legal representatives, lattice dimension, target, ports, face gluing, and recursive metric rule undefined. Searching Gram entries in [-2,2] could only reject that arbitrary finite box, while a depth-two empty ellipsoid would not prove increasing relative separation and must still contain or exclude the G13 affine lattice point explicitly.

Proposal 4 remains a linear enlarged encoding once emitted as a lattice, so G13 becomes an integral trade among lifted honest encodings. Tensor products admit the decisive one-factor mutation unless forbidden by a proved closure rule, yielding additive or constant-relative cost rather than D^t/W^t; the proposed incidence fibers, harmful class, norm, and tensor gluing are not specified.

Proposal 5 assumes the missing global-support lemma and does not explain how local selectors are forced to be projections of a polynomially represented global measure. Its experiment uses moments j=0,...,8 despite requiring K>=13, so it does not even test the stated detector; moments distinguishing assignments also lack a completeness-compatible target and scaling specification.

Proposal 6 cannot make the known G13 affine combination nonzero under any linear homology map that sends every honest encoding to zero: the same coefficient-sum-one combination maps to zero. The selector-to-chain map and relative boundary conditions are absent, and attaching a 3x3 torus tests neither polynomial cover growth nor a G20/G21 systolic recurrence.
evidence: G13 verifies a harmful integral affine combination of honest encodings, and G15 lifts it through every tested hierarchy level with zero residual below threshold.
G5 found squared-norm-at-most-four overlap circuits in every tested private-row composition, so local isolation and facewise consistency do not imply composition.
G7, G9, and G11 exhibit exact or constant-cost signed kernels, while G12 shows that charging parity can expose a cheaper clause drop.
G19 verifies an exact accepting signed flow with two negative coefficients and zero residual, directly contradicting nonnegative-fiber and splice intuitions.
G14 supplies only a finite B+32 shell pass. No verifier establishes recursive state closure, lambda>mu, polynomial relative-gap growth, or immunity to entangled depth-two states.
No proposal supplies new verifier evidence, and none currently defines a complete bounded experiment that resolves its decisive asymptotic or closure blocker.
